================================================================================
RELEASE PROCESS REDESIGN PROJECT
Complete Delivery Summary — 2026-08-05
================================================================================

PROJECT OBJECTIVE
================================================================================
Audit, redesign, and plan implementation of release process covering:
  • Control plane (.github) — Central governance
  • WordPress plugins — With version headers, readme.txt
  • WordPress themes — With style.css versioning
  • Portable agents — Reusable across organization

STATUS: Requirements & Design Phase Complete
           Ready for OpenSpec Analysis & Implementation Planning

================================================================================
CRITICAL FINDINGS
================================================================================

🔴 BLOCKING ISSUES (3):
  1. Authorization gating doesn't work (telemetry continues on error)
  2. Release flow contradicts documentation (main vs develop)
  3. Workflow badges reference non-existent workflows (broken docs)

🟠 MAJOR ISSUES (7):
  4. No post-release version sync (develop stays stale)
  5. Changelog validation timing unclear
  6. Dry-run defaults to true (easy to forget actual release)
  7. Pre-release checklist documented but not enforced
  8. Rollback automation missing (referenced but not implemented)
  9. Trigger telemetry doesn't stop unauthorized releases
  10. Release notes preview unclear in dry-runs

🟡 MEDIUM ISSUES (5):
  11. RELEASE_PROCESS.md ↔ BRANCHING_STRATEGY.md misalignment
  12. Script path references outdated in CHANGELOG_AUTOMATION.md
  13. No stacked PR strategy documentation
  14. No beta/RC version tagging guidance
  15. GitHub CLI vs shell script decision not documented

See: AUDIT_REPORT.md (complete findings & analysis)

================================================================================
SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE
================================================================================

PORTABLE RELEASE AGENTS
  • agents/release/ — Works across all repo types
  • agents/changelog/ — Separate changelog agent
  • Detects repo type automatically (plugin, theme, control plane)
  • Handles version files per repo type:
    - Plugin:  VERSION + plugin header + readme.txt + package.json
    - Theme:   VERSION + style.css header + package.json
    - Control: VERSION + package.json

DEVELOP-FIRST RELEASE FLOW
  develop → PR to develop (validate)
    ↓ merge
  develop → PR to main (final gate)
    ↓ merge + tag + release
  main (tagged)

MULTI-REPO SUPPORT
  ✅ .github control plane can release
  ✅ WordPress plugins can release (with portable agent)
  ✅ WordPress themes can release (with portable agent)
  ✅ Consistent process across all (no special cases)

GOVERNANCE & AUTHORIZATION
  • Single decision-maker (you)
  • Authorization gating fixed (blocks unauthorized users)
  • Pre-release checklist enforced by workflow
  • Audit trail logs all attempts
  • Rollback automation available

See: RFC_RELEASE_PROCESS_V2.md, MULTI_REPO_AGENT_STRATEGY.md

READY FOR OPENSPEC ANALYSIS
================================================================================

INPUTS FOR OPENSPEC:
  ✅ Complete audit report (15 issues)
  ✅ Questionnaire (50 questions answered)
  ✅ RFC (proposal & framework)
  ✅ Architecture strategy (portable agents)
  ✅ Multi-repo requirements documented

WHAT OPENSPEC WILL PRODUCE:
  → requirements.md (formal specification)
  → decision-matrix.md (dependencies & tradeoffs)
  → architecture-spec.md (detailed design with YAML, pseudocode)
  → implementation-plan.md (prioritized tasks, 18-23 days)
  → flow-diagrams.md (Mermaid diagrams)
  → conflict resolution (if any decisions conflict)

HOW TO TRIGGER:
  1. Review RFC_RELEASE_PROCESS_V2.md (15 min)
  2. Review QUESTIONNAIRE_PREPOPULATED.md answers (10 min)
  3. Modify answers if needed
  4. Message: "Approved for OpenSpec"
  5. Analysis runs automatically (2-3 hours)
  6. Review OpenSpec output
  7. Create GitHub issues & begin implementation

SUCCESS CRITERIA
================================================================================

Release Process V2 is successful when:

✅ CRITICAL ISSUES FIXED

  [ ] Release flow matches documentation exactly
  [ ] All broken links & badges fixed

✅ GOVERNANCE ESTABLISHED

  [ ] Audit trail logs all attempts
  [ ] Rollback automation available & tested

✅ MULTI-REPO SUPPORT WORKING
  [ ] Control plane can release
  [ ] Plugins can release with portable agent
  [ ] Themes can release with portable agent
  [ ] Same process for all (no special cases)

✅ ONE-BUTTON RELEASE ACHIEVED
  [ ] Run: node agents/release/release.agent.js --scope=patch
  [ ] Workflow handles everything automatically
  [ ] Time-to-release < 10 minutes

✅ DOCUMENTATION ACCURATE
  [ ] All links live & working
  [ ] Docs match code exactly
  [ ] CI prevents doc/code drift

✅ TEAM ALIGNMENT
  [ ] Team understands & approves flow
  [ ] ADRs explain major decisions
  [ ] Team can execute with confidence
